newsitem.title: SPAIN: Armed men attack Italian viceconsulate in Spain.
newsitem.headline: Armed men attack Italian viceconsulate in Spain.

text.p: Three armed men broke into the Italian vice-consulate in Malaga on Wednesday, tied up the employees and made them read a statement, an Italian embassy spokesman in Madrid said.

"Three men entered and immobilised the employees and made them read a statement written in Spanish which said...it was an action by a revolutionary group to protest against Italian justice and in favour of prisoners," the spokesman told Reuters.
The embassy said it did not know the identities of the men who broke into the vice-consulate in the southern Spanish resort or anything about the prisoners to whom they referred.
The statement, which a vice-consulate employee was forced to read, said such attacks would be repeated in all countries where the justice system worked like Italy's.
The armed men vandalised the vice-consulate and stole some money, which made the Italian embassy wonder about the motives for the attack.
"The impression we have is that it was done by common delinquents who tried to cover up their activities," the embassy spokesman said.
